Episode Notes:
The 18th BRICS summit wrapped up in New Delhi this past weekend, producing a joint declaration despite deep divisions — including between members on opposite sides of the war in the Middle East. Henrietta Levin joins the Warcast to break down the summit's outcomes and where BRICS is headed as its membership continues to grow.
